description:
AWS/Azure Engineer – Corporater Romania

📍 Location: Bucharest, Romania
🕒 Employment Type: Full-time
👤 Reports to: Head of Global IT Infrastructure
🌍 Department: Global IT & Cloud Operations
⚠️Deadline for applications: January 15th 2026

About the Role

Corporater is seeking an experienced AWS/Azure Engineer to join our IT Infrastructure team in Bucharest.

This position is being established to strengthen our centre of excellence for infrastructure operations, ensure business continuity, and uphold our global SLAs for cloud performance, availability, and security.

You will be part of a highly skilled team responsible for managing, optimising, and securing our global hybrid cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and on-premises data centres. This role replaces an existing position and aims to relieve workload pressure on the team, ensuring sustainable operations and continued excellence in service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, monitor, and optimise AWS and Azure environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates.

  • Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes in collaboration with development teams.

  • Oversee virtual machines, networking, storage, identity management, and backup strategies across environments.

  • Maintain and improve system monitoring, alerting, and incident response mechanisms.

  • Ensure compliance with corporate IT security standards, ISO 27001, and GDPR requirements.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across global offices to ensure the uptime and reliability of production and internal systems.

  • Participate in on-call rotation (1 week per month)

  • We work hybrid.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, system administration, or DevOps roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure (EC2, S3, RDS, Azure VM, Storage Accounts, VNets, etc.).

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, or container orchestration tools is a strong plus.

  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers.

  • Experience using monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus).

  • Practical experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash, etc.).

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with a proactive, “own it” mindset.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Why Join Corporater

At Corporater, we deliver integrated software solutions for Governance, Performance, Risk, and Compliance (GPRC) on a single platform used by large organisations and government institutions worldwide.
Joining our IT Infrastructure team in Romania means being part of a mission-critical function supporting our global business operations and customers across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the Americas.

We offer a collaborative, international work environment with opportunities for professional development and technical growth.

About Corporater

Corporater is a global software company that delivers integrated software solutions for governance, performance, risk, and compliance (GPRC) on a single system — the Corporater Business Management Platform.
We enable organisations to create a digital twin of their organisation, digitalise processes and operations, and drive business outcomes as a connected enterprise.

Corporater was established with a dual vision: to redefine how business applications are built and used, and to use our gains to make a social impact.
Join us in shaping our vision — we’re looking for talented individuals from diverse backgrounds to be part of our journey.

⚠️ Note: Corporater manages all global recruitment directly — no external agencies. Background checks will be conducted for all final candidates.
